rubrics.justification: Accurately notes a somewhat collapsed/contracted blastocyst appearance, limited blastocoel distension in this frame, plausible compact ICM, and no obvious heavy degeneration. Minor overcalling of TE and zona details that are difficult to confirm from this single image.

Thoroughly integrates embryo grade with age, ovarian response, tubal factor, prior IVF failures/miscarriages, semen data, smoking, and especially the very thin endometrium as the dominant prognostic modifier.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with conclusions generally supported by the case data. Minor issue is some confidence in morphology despite limited image quality and a somewhat assertive implantation estimate.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF practice: correctly flags Gardner grading nuance, supports single embryo transfer, cavity/hydrosalpinx evaluation, and thin-lining optimization. Slightly speculative adjunct suggestions are appropriately labeled as mixed-evidence.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer versus freeze-all, uterine/tubal workup, recurrent loss evaluation, endometrial optimization, and lifestyle modification, with good clinical nuance.
